common.implementation: React19 hooks/state/ref/layout effects, native JSX and forwardRef. State rerenders coordinate refs carrying synchronous effective models. Native nodes use mount-time default properties, while committed React owner props reconcile through layout effects; no DOM controller mounting, iframe or innerHTML.
common.callback_order: Ordinary text input delivers React onInput, then React onChange; onChange runs before onValueChange. Checkbox standard onClick/onChange remain native React handlers and precede onCheckedChange. preventDefault on native onChange or onNativeBeforeInput vetoes proposal; onValueChange/onCheckedChange are proposal notifications, returns/promises ignored, preventDefault there is not a model veto. Controlled refusal uses unchanged owner props. Exceptions propagate and the interrupted proposal does not commit. No input data logs/network/storage. Standard onClick cancellation (including nativeEvent.preventDefault observed by the React change handler) suppresses the internal boolean proposal while standard onChange is still forwarded. A throwing standard onChange rethrows and restores the latest accepted model. Later post-dispatch cancellation is not a rollback API.
common.synchronous_owner: Committed owner value/checked/ownership/ownerRevision changes take priority over in-flight event work. Batched React updates are observed when they commit, not when setState is merely scheduled. Test runner must inject __flushSync for explicit synchronous owner/replace/destroy cases. Same-value rerender is not distinguishable from metadata and is not a command; ownerRevision is explicit.
common.form_reset: Document capture observes real reset. A microtask after default action reconciles each field using its current input.form, owner revision and user intent. Dispatch-time ordinary edits precede reset. Valid edits/new composition after reset returns retire old reset, even native same-value input intent. Controlled current owner wins; unowned fields return to mount baseline. No change callbacks emitted by reset. Native defaultValue/defaultChecked mirror mount baseline or current owner to protect new nodes. Replacements can join an already-observed active same-module reset dispatch.
common.reset_cancel: Only preventDefault during dispatch is supported. Independent jobs cover valid/valid, valid/cancel, cancel/valid, cancel/cancel. Deferred cancellation flag read is subject to the known late-post-dispatch preventDefault limitation: DOM may already have reset while a later canceled flag skips model reconciliation. Not globally intercepting Event.prototype or form.reset. Earlier stopImmediatePropagation preventing observation is outside guarantee.
common.focus: Stable native nodes on metadata/validation renders. No automatic focus. Caret restoration only when native field remains activeElement; synchronous focus takeover/destroy stops stale work. Owner prop replacement may affect undo stack.
common.cleanup: Effect cleanup unsubscribes reset/beforeinput listeners, invalidates job generations and composition tails. StrictMode setup/cleanup and detached references must be tested independently. No timeouts/intervals/network or persistent data.
common.styles: Scoped .fr7; external Provider tokens accepted without context. Local explicit foreground/background/placeholder/focus pairs; system fonts; no copied commercial images/fonts. Follow target first; other seven-theme tokens are only portability, not849 acceptance.
common.validation: Native validity attributes forwarded; error text associates aria-invalid/description but does not invent server validation. Native maxLength/minLength use UTF-16 units. Synthetic text proposals over maxLength rejected whole; owner/default values not truncated.
common.pending: All authored tests currently unrun. Exact React runtime, controlled/reset callback boundaries, real keyboard/browser, IME, pixels, focus contrast and animations need new evidence. No native500/456 tests inherited.

items.react_structure: Native React JSX with stable field nodes and forwarded refs; not a frozen DOM adapter wrapper.
items.scope: This exact canonical ID; no native/Flutter/other849 coverage credit.
items.native_API: Standard input attributes/events except fixed input type/children. value/defaultValue/onValueChange, label/help/error/ownerRevision, native modern onNativeBeforeInput hook. Forwarded ref points to native field.
items.ownership: Defined value owns, null is controlled empty, undefined releases last effective value. Mount-only defaultValue supplies reset baseline. Explicit ownerRevision change cancels stale composition/reset even if value unchanged. Same-value renders and metadata updates preserve drafts.
items.form: Native name/form/required/pattern(minus textarea)/length constraints forwarded. No invented form or submit handler. Shared reset contract applies. Native browser validity reporting is not simulated.
items.IME: Intermediate draft remains DOM-only; native React onChange/onInput callbacks still delivered. onValueChange deferred until one compositionend. Owner value/ownership/ownerRevision or disabled/readOnly changes and effective reset cancel old session. Tombstone rejects stale end/input until fresh noncomposing beforeinput/paste or compositionstart. Unchanged controlled renders do not cancel.
items.selection: Stable node and unchanged .value preserve selection. Forced normalization/owner replacement restores or clamps selection only if field still owns focus; never refocuses. Textarea delegates native undo; mask has bounded100-entry local undo. Native OS undo equivalence not claimed.
limitations: Real OS IME event ordering, native clipboard/autofill, browser reset/undo and accessibility tree remain untested.
Old canceled IME tails without a fresh beforeinput/compositionstart are blocked; browsers/input tools lacking those recovery signals may require a new composition or remount.
External direct .value writes without an input event are not model updates.

mask_contract.format: Seven fixed slots AA99 AAA; literal space index4; partial nonempty slots use underscores; empty remains empty. No hover mask insertion.
mask_contract.character_policy: Independent bounded adapter: A permits BMP [A-Za-z\u00c0-\u00ff\u0400-\u04ff\u00b5] only when uppercase is one UTF-16 unit. Digit slots permit one BMP Unicode Number. Supplementary codepoints and expanding uppercase are rejected. These ranges are adapter policy derived from prior authored editor, not a newly verified Inputmask token contract.
mask_contract.editing: Modern cancelable beforeinput insertText/deleteContentBackward/deleteContentForward performs fixed-slot overwrite/delete, selection replacement and caret placement; paste uses same algorithm. Invalid standalone characters do not advance; invalid bulk characters consume a slot. Native fallback input reformats entire value and may differ from dependency caret/edit behavior.
mask_contract.history: Local undo/redo max100 accepted formatted edits; Ctrl/Meta+Z/Y or historyUndo/Redo beforeinput. Owner/safety commands and completed reset clear history; newer accepted post-reset edit protects history. No full Inputmask/native undo equivalence.
mask_contract.native_events: Custom beforeinput/paste/history edits emit onValueChange and retain the original native/React event. They do not fabricate input/change or dispatch a fake React onChange. onNativeBeforeInput can veto before internal prevention. Standard onBeforeInput remains React synthetic behavior.
mask_contract.length: Serialized partial/full mask length8. Explicit maxLength<8 rejects nonempty formatted user proposals; owner/default strings are normalized without truncation.
mask_contract.validation: No added mask completion error or required constraint by default; helper is instructional. Caller error/required/pattern remain explicit.
mask_contract.dependency_gap: use-mask-input3.14.2 lock integrity recorded; dependency source/runtime not acquired for this slice. Full A/9 token, placeholder-on-focus, clearIncomplete, unmask, caret/IME/undo parity unknown. Package not needed by consumers.

differences: Independent React fixed-slot editor replaces use-mask-input runtime. Old native mask value:undefined reverted props.defaultValue; this React release intentionally retains last effective value.
System glyph replaces source HiIdentification icon. Source font/image assets not copied.
